TCP::rt_metrics_timeout
Description
This iRule command sets the metrics cache entry time to live (in
seconds) for the current connection. Only applies to iRule events
CLIENT_CLOSED and SERVER_CLOSED, which is approximately when TCP
stores entries. This can also be used to purge the entry by using a
timeout of 0. This information pushes to all CMPs.
Syntax
TCP
::
rt_metrics_timeout
<
timeout
(
s
)
>
Examples
Related Information
Valid Events:
CLIENT_CLOSED,SERVER_CLOSED
